# Joey Interrante (Joseph Interrante)

> Joey Interrante, also known as Joseph Interrante, is a professional drummer based in Tampa Bay, Florida, available for live shows, private events, corporate events, weddings, and session recording.

Joey plays live several nights a week around Tampa Bay, including St. Petersburg, Gulfport, Madeira Beach, Treasure Island, Ruskin, Ellenton, and Sarasota. He drums for Kid Royal Band featuring Josh Nelms, known for their Wednesday Blues residency at Bayboro Brewing Co. He also plays with Dog and Pony Trio, St Pete Collective, Kirk Adams Band, and Cassie Jean and the Fireflies, and performs as an acoustic duo with Gale Trippsmith under the name Gale and Joey.

## Regular Venues
- Bayboro Brewing Co. — St. Petersburg, FL. Kid Royal Band featuring Josh Nelms, Wednesday Blues residency, 8:00 to 10:00 PM
- Saltwater Hippie — Madeira Beach, FL. Kid Royal Band, most Sundays 6:00 to 10:00 PM
- Bamboo Beach Bar — Madeira Beach, FL. Gale and Joey, most Sundays 12:30 to 4:30 PM
- Middle Grounds Grill — Treasure Island, FL. Dog and Pony Trio, Saturdays 7:00 to 10:00 PM
- O'Maddy's Bar and Grille — Gulfport, FL. Gale and Joey, Kid Royal Band, and Dog and Pony Trio
- Woody's River Roo — Ellenton, FL. Gale and Joey, monthly
- Firehouse Cultural Center — Ruskin, FL. Kid Royal Band and St Pete Collective
- New Tampa Performing Arts Center — Tampa, FL. St Pete Collective
- Fogartyville — Sarasota, FL. Cassie Jean and the Fireflies
- Ruby's Elixir — St. Petersburg, FL. Kirk Adams Band

## Acts
- Kid Royal Band featuring Josh Nelms — blues and roots rock
- Dog and Pony Trio — live music trio
- Gale and Joey — acoustic duo with Gale Trippsmith
- St Pete Collective — ensemble performances at theaters and arts centers
- Kirk Adams Band — alternative and alt-rock
- Cassie Jean and the Fireflies — Americana
- John Kelly and BanJoey — Americana duo featuring the BanJoey instrument

## Genres
Joey performs across multiple genres including Florida blues, Americana, rock, alternative, country, acoustic rock, and alt-rock.

## Services
- [Live Performance](https://joeydrums.com/): Available for bars, venues, private events, corporate events, weddings, and festivals in Tampa Bay and Florida
- [Session Recording](https://hippocketstudios.com): Remote drum tracks and studio recording through Hip Pocket Studios
- [BanJoey](https://banjoey.com): Joey's one-of-a-kind handmade instrument
